summary: Fangdd Network Group filed an ordinary Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements for the period ending June 30, 2026, with no special-situation transaction disclosed. The excerpt consists solely of XBRL tagging for related-party balances—other payables, other receivables, accounts receivable and income-sharing arrangements with entities including Shanghai Nuancheng, Deyan, Chongkai, Jiushen, Detong and Longshu Tianye. No stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor mandate, tender, merger or strategic review terms appear. This is a routine periodic report; no deal mechanics, regulatory clock or arbitrage angle apply to this filing.
